note_sections.t: Sustained PSA elevation alongside a Negative prior biopsy defines the current clinical presentation.

Recent outpatient assessments covered routine thyroid function screening and an ophthalmology consultation for early cataract development, both demonstrating stability. Geographic distance places his residence over ninety minutes from the medical center, prompting a specific preference for remote telephone consultations during subsequent care phases.

DRE — prostate texture: asymmetrically hypertrophied with a distinct, firm nodule localized to the right mid-gland. General assessment remains within normal limits, displaying unremarkable cardiopulmonary findings and stable resting vital parameters.
